### Protecting His Own
Author: Alistair Begg
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/truth-for-life/truth-for-life-july-6-2017.html
Passage: Proverbs 1:33
Points:
- God’s love and faithful care shine most clearly amid times of distress and judgment.
- Scripture illustrates how the Lord preserved Elijah and his faithful remnant during national famine.
- Believers remain safe under God's protection, whether through earthly preservation or in eternity.
- Followers of Christ should not be shaken or overwhelmed by fear of worldly turmoil.
- Trusting God's promises frees Christians to show the world the blessing of listening to wisdom.
